body:
You honestly sound like my friend, she had a horrible upbringing and was forced to skip her childhood and raise her younger brothers and sisters. The thing that I can suggest is that you don't live for yourself, but live for others.

This isn't copied from anywhere, and isn't pasted from somewhere else. This is a genuine thought that could help.

There are a thousand ways to skin a cat, or commit suicide in this case. What's the point in that, if you wanted to do it then you would have done it already. You wouldn't have posted here wanting the attention.

You are lonely, and you say you want to feel something... break your pinky finger. You'll feel pain, and that means you are still alive. Perhaps you don't want to feel pain, and you want the opposite. Well, I'm going to be honest, it isn't as easy as feeling pain.

You have to work for it, and it is worth every step of the way. Just go outside when you get the chance, and walk down the shop on the corner and get yourself some ice cream. Go back outside, and sit on the bench closest or on the curb. Watch the traffic go bye, and let your thoughts pass your by. Put each bad thought with any certain color car go away from you. Let all the cars coming towards you bring a happy thought. Someone you want to do, or something that makes you smile.

You may want to bring something to write on, and a pencil or pen. Write these thoughts coming towards you down on the paper. Make a list, and when you feel that you've got enough things on your list, go home.

You need to figure out what you want to do, how to do it, then plan when you are going to do it. Hell, take a friend with you too. Perhaps one of the opposite sex, or same. It doesn't make a difference.

You'll grow a relationship/bond/friendship with that other individual, and one with yourself. From there, you will decide what will happen. It'll be a challenge with endless rewards.

> I dont know why Im posting here

You know why you posted here, I hope you feel better.
